sloka: यद्यन्यथा भवेदेतद्द्वौ मासौ जीवितं मम ।न मां द्रक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थो म्रिये सा ऽहमनाथवत् ।। ५.५८.१०६ ।।।।
transliteration: yadyanyathā bhavedetaddvau māsau jīvitaṁ mama ।na māṁ drakṣyati kākutstho mriye sā 'hamanāthavat ।। 5.58.106 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Otherwise with none to protect me, I will live only for two months.I will die like an orphan and he will not see me'.
